verdict.rationale: ReadMe's Reusable Content feature lets admins create Markdown blocks reused across multiple pages, with edits automatically propagating to every instance ('Edit once, update everywhere'), directly matching the snippet-sync story; variables are less explicitly documented separately. missing for 10: dedicated documentation/example of a distinct 'variables' feature (vs. reusable Markdown blocks) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
